posts.title: Firefox 159.0.1
posts.text:
Version 159.0.1, first offered to Release channel users on November 3, 2026

-

Fixed the dot that marks a tab needing attention being hard to see with some themes, depending on the system accent color. (Bug 2086347)

-

Fixed a command prompt window briefly appearing on Windows when Firefox restarts to apply an update. (Bug 2081809)

-

Fixed passkey sign-in failing on websites that share passkeys across related sites, such as Facebook and Instagram. (Bug 2085450)

-

Fixed crashes on Windows that could occur with some antivirus or other security software installed, in some cases also leaving WebGL disabled. (Bug 2083648)

-

Fixed red and blue colors appearing swapped on some websites that use WebGL on Linux, including video call background effects. (Bug 2087301)

-

Updated time zone data to reflect Cuba's decision not to end daylight saving time on November 1, 2026. (Bug 2086609)

-

Fixed text in some Settings descriptions, such as security warnings, breaking in the middle of words. (Bug 2086282)
